paragraphs.text: Whale is a creature type used for marine mammals that can vary greatly in size. Distinguishing features include fluked tails and blowholes for expelling water. They are hunted as a source of meat, blubber, and bone.
All printed Whales are blue -aligned. They are predominently mono- blue except for Ukkima, Stalking Shadow which is blue-black and Spectacular Skywhale in blue-red .

The first creature to bear the type was Killer Whale in Exodus . The type reappeared in Urza's Saga on Great Whale . , until Magic 2014 added the Colossal Whale . The Kaladesh block introduced Long-Finned Skywhale in Kaladesh , and Aethertide Whale in Aether Revolt .
Before Khans of Tarkir ' s Wetland Sambar (an elk ), whales were the only real-world mammals (aside from humans ) to be featured in blue .
Commander 2020 printed the first legendary whale, Ukkima, Stalking Shadow . Whales would continue to be sporadically printed over later sets.
In the Grand Creature Type Update the subtype Narwhal ( Narwhal ) was errataed to Whale.
The Skywhales of Avishkar are found in the aethersphere of the plane, living in the sky instead of the sea . They are hunted by whalers.
Elemental whales can be found in both the seas and skies of Ikoria , where they are known to be taken as companions by Bonders.
Narwhals can be found on Ulgrotha , where their horns are wielded as weapons by sea Trolls .
Enormous space whales wander the Edge , flying through the space between worlds.
Ukkima is a wolf whale (although closer in size to a dolphin), companion of Cazur .
